POWER MECHANICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. When learning Electrical Systems, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Systems.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Systems.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Systems.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems.

3. When learning Careers in Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers in Power Mechanics.

   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Systems 3.2 Electronic Systems 3.3 Vehicle transmission systems 3.4 O.

8. When learning Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Business enterprises related to Power Mechanics.

9. When learning Assembly drawing and Sectioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
